service.en: Renewal of a health professional licence
service.ur: صحت پیشہ ور کے لائسنس کی تجدید

about: Renew the licence of a doctor, nurse, technician or pharmacist.
note: Requirements read from the official MOHAP service page on the checked date. Field labels sit behind sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Holds an active or expired licence with the applying facility
Doctors aged 60 or over need a physical and mental fitness report
Clean UAE track record and a facility with a valid licence
Government facility licences renew automatically at expiry
documents: Physical and mental report for doctors aged 60 or over
fees: Application fee 100 AED (private and semi-government facilities)
Private facilities: 3,000 AED doctors, 1,000 AED nurses, technicians and pharmacists
